{{Quote|Did you hear something? I heard something. Sounded like a faint roar of some giant creature.|A [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] guard, about [[Ageaughu]]|<ref name="SWG:SG" />}}
A '''carax''' was a large six-legged [[Insect/Legends|insectoid]] creature [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Rrynt'vor]], the overlord of the [[Rak'qua]] tribe, owned a carax named [[Ageaughu]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the beast lived in a cave of [[Station Gamma]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:SG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The carax appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The carax was one of the many creatures created during the development of the ''Star Wars Galaxies''.<ref name="DVD">[[Star Wars Galaxies Bonus DVD|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Bonus DVD]]</ref> However, the creature was cut from the original game. A carax, known as Ageaughu, was finally added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:SG" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Nevertheless, the creature was never identified as a carax in the game.<ref name="SWG:SG" /> The species name could be found in the original concept arts<ref name="DVD" /> and in the game files.<ref name="File">{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; shared_carax.iff, client_shared_cr_carax.cdf, carax.dds, carax_teeth.dds, carax.lmg, carax.sat, creature_acklay_carax.pal, carax_body.ddscarax_body_hcsb21.sht...</ref>
